create_nested_cross_validation: create nested cross-validation with GridSearchCV inner loop and cross_val_score outer loop to estimate generalization error
build_grid_search_cv: build a GridSearchCV pipeline with SVC RBF kernel and parameter grid for C and gamma hyperparameters
test_kfold_splitting: test KFold cross-validation with configurable n_splits, shuffle, and random_state for inner and outer loops
compare_nested_vs_non_nested: compare nested and non-nested cross-validation scores on the iris dataset across multiple random trials
plot_cv_score_differences: plot nested and non-nested CV scores and their differences using matplotlib bar and line charts
